<head>
<meta charset="utf-8"/>
<meta content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" name="viewport"/>
<title>Intelligence Report - Social Media Monitoring</title>
<script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" rel="preconnect"/>
<link crossorigin="" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" rel="preconnect"/>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"/>
<style>
        :root {
            --primary-dark: #1a202c;
            --secondary-dark: #2d3748;
            --accent-blue: #3182ce;
            --accent-green: #38a169;
            --accent-yellow: #d69e2e;
            --accent-red: #e53e3e;
            --light-gray: #f7fafc;
            --medium-gray: #e2e8f0;
            --dark-gray: #718096;
        }
        
        body {
            font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
            background-color: var(--light-gray);
            color: var(--primary-dark);
            padding: 20px;
            margin: 0;
        }
        
        .card {
            background-color: white;
            border-radius: 12px;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
            transition: box-shadow 0.3s ease;
        }
        
        .card:hover {
            box-shadow: 0 10px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
        }
        
        .sentiment-negative {
            color: var(--accent-red);
            background-color: rgba(229, 62, 62, 0.1);
        }
        
        .sentiment-neutral {
            color: var(--accent-yellow);
            background-color: rgba(214, 158, 46, 0.1);
        }
        
        .sentiment-positive {
            color: var(--accent-green);
            background-color: rgba(56, 161, 105, 0.1);
        }
        
        .platform-twitter {
            color: #1da1f2;
            border-color: #1da1f2;
        }
        
        .platform-instagram {
            color: #e1306c;
            border-color: #e1306c;
        }
        
        .platform-facebook {
            color: #4267B2;
            border-color: #4267B2;
        }
        
        .platform-youtube {
            color: #ff0000;
            border-color: #ff0000;
        }
        
        .platform-whatsapp {
            color: #25d366;
            border-color: #25d366;
        }
        
        .chart-bar {
            height: 20px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }
        
        .chart-container {
            height: 200px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-end;
            justify-content: space-around;
            padding: 20px 0;
        }
        
        .chart-label {
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            text-align: center;
            margin-top: 5px;
        }
        
        .keyword-chip {
            background-color: var(--medium-gray);
            border-radius: 20px;
            padding: 4px 12px;
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            margin-right: 8px;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
            display: inline-block;
        }
        
        .header-section {
            border-bottom: 2px solid var(--medium-gray);
            padding-bottom: 15px;
            margin-bottom: 25px;
        }
        
        .section-title {
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            color: var(--secondary-dark);
        }
        
        .data-value {
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 1.8rem;
        }
        
        .data-label {
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            color: var(--dark-gray);
        }
        
        .post-card {
            border-left: 4px solid var(--accent-blue);
        }
        
        .post-author {
            font-weight: 600;
        }
        
        .post-text {
            font-size: 0.95rem;
            line-height: 1.5;
        }
        
        .post-meta {
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            color: var(--dark-gray);
        }
        
        @media print {
            body {
                padding: 0;
                margin: 0;
            }
            
            .card {
                box-shadow: none;
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>
